verdict.rationale: Canva's official MCP server and AI Connector let users drive Canva through natural language from their AI assistants. Documented operations include generating designs from text descriptions, applying targeted edits via natural-language commands, searching the library, managing assets and brand kits, exporting, resizing and commenting. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that natural-language editing works as claimed, in-product Canva AI command support beyond a passing mention, and clarity on plan gating (resizing requires Pro and above).
